{"id": 6775055895703, "url": "https://cleo.zendesk.com/api/v2/help_center/en-us/articles/6775055895703.json", "html_url": "https://support.cleo.com/hc/en-us/articles/6775055895703-IP-Allowlist-Expansion", "author_id": 361750296453, "comments_disabled": false, "draft": false, "promoted": false, "position": 12, "vote_sum": 1, "vote_count": 1, "section_id": 360005127514, "created_at": "2022-06-14T20:10:34Z", "updated_at": "2026-09-24T16:49:32Z", "name": "IP Allowlist Expansion", "title": "IP Allowlist Expansion", "source_locale": "en-us", "locale": "en-us", "outdated": false, "outdated_locales": [], "edited_at": "2023-02-09T16:01:09Z", "user_segment_id": null, "permission_group_id": 511634, "content_tag_ids": [], "label_names": [], "body": "

Since some older trading partners may have allowlisted the original 4 IP addresses for CIC, some inbound connections (Partner Mailbox, AS2, OFTP) and some outbound connections (AS2, OFTP, FTP(S), and SFTP) have been restricted to the original set of 4 IP addresses.

Cleo Capacity Planning for CIC now mandates the expansion of the IP address list for these protocols beyond the original set to include the expanded CIDR Block of 256 addresses:

192.245.195.0/24

This expansion will take effect on July 11, 2022. If you have internal systems or trading partners who have allowlisted the original set of 4 IP addresses, they will need to update their allowlist configurations before this date.

Visit CIC Inbound and Outbound Connections for more information.
